## Pages

## Modules

- [QMI](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.md): Qualcomm MSM Interface in Elixir
- [QMI.Codec.UserIdentity](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.Codec.UserIdentity.md): Codec for making user identity service requests

- [QMI.Supervisor](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.Supervisor.md): Main supervisor for QMI processes

- [QMI.UserIdentity](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.UserIdentity.md): Provides commands related to the user identity service

- Services
  - [QMI.Control](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.Control.md): Provides commands related to QMUX link and client management

  - [QMI.DeviceManagement](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.DeviceManagement.md): Device Management service requests

  - [QMI.NetworkAccess](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.NetworkAccess.md): Provides commands related to network access

  - [QMI.WirelessData](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.WirelessData.md): Provides command related to wireless messaging

- Codec
  - [QMI.Codec.Control](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.Codec.Control.md): Codec for making control service requests

  - [QMI.Codec.DeviceManagement](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.Codec.DeviceManagement.md): Codec for making device management requests

  - [QMI.Codec.NetworkAccess](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.Codec.NetworkAccess.md): Codec for making network access service requests

  - [QMI.Codec.WirelessData](https://qmi.hexdocs.pm/QMI.Codec.WirelessData.md): Codec for making wireless data service requests
